chapter: Childhood in Oklahoma, Kansas City and Tulsa
title: Playing in a high school band for John Philip Sousa
summary: He played trumpet in a Tulsa high school band parade for Sousa.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: I had the privilege of playing in the high school band for the benefit of John Philip Sousa. They had a parade of high school bands in Tulsa, Oklahoma. I didn't win any awards, but I played for him. That's a lot that quite a few people can't say.
That was around '33, '34. '33 or '34. Because I had just been playing about two years.
